card.name: Million and thousand-scale number words
card.fires_on: The start of large-quantity words like million, billion and millennium, or the spot just before a large number. It is often after 'per one' or 'greater than'.

modes.label: Start of mill-/Bill- words
modes.description: The opening piece of million, billion or millennium.
modes.example: APPROXIMATELY SIX PATIENTS PER ONE<< MILL>>ION POPULATION PER YEAR

modes.label: Before a large dose figure
modes.description: The gap or small word right before a big number, such as an LD50 value in mg/kg.
modes.example: for sulphur is reported to be greater than<< >>5,000 mg/kg.

card.writes: It suppresses 'pet' and 'ter' continuations and slightly favors 'MP'-type pieces, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to give a very large number, such as a million or a huge lethal dose.
